assumptions: The 32 COCOSSim cores stand in for the 32 TensorCores in a 16-chip TPU7x slice and apply ideal output-dimension sharding; the simulator does not model the dual-chiplet hierarchy.
The vector width is an explicit proxy assumption because Google does not publish an equivalent COCOSSim vector-lane count.

The 1 GHz value normalizes raw COCOSSim cycles and is not asserted to be the physical TPU7x clock; absolute analytical time uses only published aggregate chip peaks and a dimensionless efficiency normalized against the same 32-core proxy.
Compute-only COCOSSim cycles are paired with a separate roofline calculation because the repository's DRAMSim3 configuration models legacy HBM2, not TPU7x HBM.
The global 8-bit simulator datatype affects storage and buffer chunking, not compute precision; mixed MXFP4/MXFP8 and unquantized tensors are accounted for only in the analytical report.
Generated traces already flatten batch times query tokens into matrix M, so the simulator runtime batch size must remain 1.
Tensor, expert, and context parallel communication are excluded from the COCOSSim cycle result and must be reported as unsupported overheads.
config.description: A transparent COCOSSim proxy plus an official-spec roofline target. This is not a cycle-accurate TPU7x hardware model.
config.name: tpu7x-ironwood-16chip-kimi-k3-proxy

roofline_precision.compute_peak: mixed: FP8 for routed experts and latent-MoE projections, BF16 otherwise

global_limitations: No TPU7x hardware was used; latency and throughput are uncalibrated proxy bounds.
COCOSSim cycles are compute-only normalized cycles and are not converted with a guessed TPU clock.
Representative blocks are extrapolated with the exact 1/68/24 text-decoder layer mix.
Tensor-parallel collectives, topology contention, XLA fusion/layout, host overhead, and sampling are excluded.
The vision tower is outside the modeled scope.

ici.excluded: tensor-parallel collectives, topology hops, contention, and expert imbalance

mixed_precision.policy: MXFP4-targeted routed-expert and latent-MoE projection GEMMs use FP8 peak; all remaining modeled GEMMs use BF16 peak

routing.expert_layout_interpretation: One flattened expert GEMM with exact aggregate MACs but optimistic M geometry.
routing.expert_token_multiplier_interpretation: Scales processed expert-token rows to represent padding or imbalance overhead; it does not change top-k routes or the number of unique experts.

simulation.cycle_interpretation: Normalized compute-only COCOSSim cycles; not TPU clock cycles. The full count is 1*dense-KDA + 68*KDA-MoE + 24*MLA-MoE.
